what: dual by mixture over the FULL alternative set (d, x), exact rational, closed form, no solver
why_it_works: general_poly is AFFINE in eta, so max over eta in [0,cap] of E_Q[G] is max at an endpoint; the dual LP then has two inequality constraints and a basic optimum of support <= 2
not_established: the design family is still B1's one-parameter eta family; this closes max_eta min_alt for THAT family, not the unrestricted design problem
column generation is a search; validity comes from any finite ALT giving a valid U and any eta a valid L
